blocks.text: Read the chapter with this setting in view: The Great Isaiah Scroll is an almost complete sixty-six-chapter witness broadly aligned with the Masoretic tradition but containing thousands of orthographic and substantive differences; other Qumran Isaiah manuscripts and pesharim show active transmission and interpretation. It gives a starting point for following the chapter's own movement. The chapter itself should determine how far the point is taken. Interpretations differ on some details.
